plain_summary: This page continues the discussion on Port Dues, detailing additional reductions and a list of exemptions. It then introduces Berth Dues, specifying the rates payable by vessels occupying a repair quay or other non-cargo handling berth, based on a tiered tonnage structure. Conditions for free periods at berths for cargo handling vessels are also provided.
